successCriteria.description: A Jest test file exists under tests/unit/modules/leave/ that covers countLeaveDays: inclusive calendar-day count (endDate - startDate + 1), UTC-normalized so time-of-day and DST do not change the result, and no weekend/holiday exclusion.

Tests cover submit orchestration: actorId===employeeId and date/leaveTypeId validation reject with ValidationError (400/VALIDATION_ERROR); missing employee/leave-type/active-policy reject with NotFoundError (404/NOT_FOUND); on success balance is found or auto-created from policy entitlement, balanceService.reserve(n) is called, request is created with status SUBMITTED, a SUBMIT audit entry is recorded, and the manager is notified only when managerId is set.

Tests cover approve orchestration: non-SUBMITTED status → ValidationError; self-approval → AuthorizationError (403/AUTHORIZATION_ERROR); n > availableDays → InsufficientBalanceError (422/INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE); intersecting APPROVED request for the same employee (any leave type) → OverlapError (422/POLICY_VIOLATION); success calls balanceService.approve(n), updates to APPROVED with approvedBy/approvedAt, records APPROVE audit, and notifies the employee.

Tests cover reject and cancel orchestration: reject requires a truthy rejectionReason (ValidationError) and SUBMITTED status, then balanceService.reject(n), REJECTED update, REJECT audit, employee notification; cancel permits SUBMITTED or APPROVED, requires owner or UserRole.HR_ADMIN (else AuthorizationError), maps status to 'PENDING'/'APPROVED' for balanceService.cancel, updates to CANCELLED, records CANCEL audit, and notifies the employee.

Tests verify the balance year is always derived from startDate.getFullYear() — a request crossing 31 Dec (e.g. 2026-12-30 → 2027-01-02) is charged in full to the start date's year and never split — across submit/approve/reject/cancel.

Tests verify single-transaction behavior: when unitOfWork.withTransaction is used, the captured client is passed as the last argument to every internal call (requestRepository.update, balanceService.approve/reject/cancel, auditService.record, notificationService.notify); when a caller-owned client is passed in, withTransaction is NOT called and the same client is propagated.

constraints: Only test files under tests/unit/modules/leave/ may be created; leave.model.ts, leave.repository.ts, leave.service.ts, leave.controller.ts, leave.routes.ts, and src/app.ts are read-only inputs owned by sibling sub-phases and must not be modified.

LeaveService must be instantiated with mocks for all 9 constructor dependencies in order (requestRepository, balanceService, balanceRepository, employeeRepository, leaveTypeRepository, policyRepository, auditService, notificationService, unitOfWork) — omitting any would fall back to a concrete default and break unit isolation.

Tests must mock the injected interfaces directly (jest.Mocked<IInterface> with jest.fn() per method) and must NOT mock the pg pool or src/shared/db/connection.ts — LeaveService depends on interfaces, not the pool.

Tests must follow existing conventions: place under tests/unit/modules/leave/, import source via relative path ../../../../src/..., and use repository.update.mockImplementation(async (b) => b) passthrough where the returned updated entity is asserted.

Assertions must match the actual error contract in src/shared/types/errors.ts: ValidationError 400/VALIDATION_ERROR, AuthorizationError 403/AUTHORIZATION_ERROR, NotFoundError 404/NOT_FOUND, InsufficientBalanceError 422/INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, OverlapError 422/POLICY_VIOLATION.
outOfScope: Creating or modifying src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts, leave.repository.ts, leave.service.ts, leave.controller.ts, leave.routes.ts, and src/app.ts — these are owned by sibling sub-phases 4a/4b.
Testing the controller/routes layer (header auth, role checks, JSON schema validation, HTTP status mapping) — this phase covers only the service and countLeaveDays helper.
Testing the repository (PgLeaveRequestRepository) SQL/mapRow behavior or mocking the pg pool — the service tests mock the injected interfaces directly.

entityInvariants.invariant: A LeaveRequest transitions SUBMITTED → APPROVED (with approvedBy/approvedAt) or SUBMITTED → REJECTED (with rejectedBy/rejectedAt/rejectionReason), and SUBMITTED or APPROVED → CANCELLED (with cancelledBy/cancelledAt); no other status transitions are permitted by the service.

Balance counters are mutated only through the injected IBalanceService (reserve/approve/reject/cancel) with the day count n computed once via countLeaveDays; the service never mutates usedDays/pendingDays directly.
No two APPROVED requests for the same employee may have intersecting [startDate, endDate] ranges, regardless of leave type — enforced at approval time via findApprovedOverlapping.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns endDate - startDate + 1 inclusive calendar days, UTC-normalized; no weekend/holiday exclusion; must be the single day-count implementation imported by all call sites.
ValidationError for invalid dates/leaveTypeId; NotFoundError for missing employee/leave-type/active-policy; creates SUBMITTED request and reserves balance.
ValidationError for non-SUBMITTED; InsufficientBalanceError when n > availableDays; OverlapError on intersecting APPROVED request; NotFoundError when balance missing.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Actor must be the request owner or UserRole.HR_ADMIN (AuthorizationError otherwise).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: ValidationError for status other than SUBMITTED/APPROVED; maps APPROVED→'APPROVED' else 'PENDING' for balanceService.cancel.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Tests must import and assert against the exact error classes/status codes/codes defined in src/shared/types/errors.ts (ValidationError 400, AuthorizationError 403, NotFoundError 404, InsufficientBalanceError 422, OverlapError 422/POLICY_VIOLATION).

Tests must use the canonical enum values from src/shared/types/enums.ts (LeaveRequestStatus DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED; UserRole employee/manager/hr_admin) rather than redeclaring literals.

Tests must match the actual method signatures and orchestration order of LeaveService (submit/approve/reject/cancel, countLeaveDays usage, balance-year derivation from startDate.getFullYear(), withUnitOfWork client propagation).

Tests must mock the exact interface methods LeaveService depends on (ILeaveRequestRepository, IBalanceService, ILeaveBalanceRepository, IEmployeeRepository, ILeaveTypeRepository, ILeavePolicyRepository, IAuditService, INotificationService, IUnitOfWork) with the optional-client-as-last-parameter contract.

Tests must verify the transaction boundary contract: the service owns the unit of work via injected IUnitOfWork.withTransaction, and every internal call receives the same client as its last argument (or the caller-owned client when passed in).

integrationPoints.why: LeaveService delegates all balance counter mutations (reserve/approve/reject/cancel) and availability derivation (getAvailableDays) to this service; tests mock it and assert the correct n and requestStatus arguments.
Every state-changing operation records an audit entry (SUBMIT/APPROVE/REJECT/CANCEL) via auditService.record with the same transaction client.
Each operation notifies the employee (or manager on submit) via notificationService.notify with the same transaction client.
The service owns the transaction boundary through the injected IUnitOfWork; tests capture the client it supplies to assert single-transaction propagation.
